scripts.build: tsc -b . && pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run build:computer
scripts.package:dev: pnpm run build && APP_VARIANT=development electron-forge package
scripts.build:overlay: esbuild src/overlay/overlay-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --external:electron --outfile=dist/src/overlay/overlay-preload.cjs && esbuild src/overlay/page/overlay-page.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=chrome140 --outfile=dist/src/overlay/overlay-page.js && esbuild src/overlay/page/overlay.css --bundle --loader:.ttf=file --asset-names=fonts/[name] --outfile=dist/src/overlay/overlay.css && tsx packaging/overlay-assets.ts
scripts.build:shell: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --external:electron --outfile=dist/src/main.js '--banner:js=import { createRequire as createDesktopRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createDesktopRequire(import.meta.url);' && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --external:electron --outfile=dist/src/preload.cjs && pnpm run build:overlay
scripts.package:release: pnpm run prepare:web && pnpm run build:shell && APP_VARIANT=release electron-forge package
scripts.make:release: pnpm run prepare:web && pnpm run build:shell && APP_VARIANT=release electron-forge make
